title: Add AppRoot TabView
description: Create CookbookApp/AppRoot.swift. Defines a TabView containing exactly three tabs in spec order: RecipesTab (label 'Recipes', SF Symbol 'book.closed'), MealPlansTab (label 'Meal Plans', SF Symbol 'calendar'), ShoppingListsTab (label 'Shopping Lists', SF Symbol 'cart'). Each tab item uses tabItem { Label(...) }.
acceptance_criteria: TabView contains exactly three tabs in order: Recipes, Meal Plans, Shopping Lists
Tab item SF Symbols are book.closed, calendar, cart respectively
